# Database summary {.unnumbered}

```{r set}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r prep}
#| eval: false
read_tsv("db/guyaclim.tsv") |> 
  select(site, project, sensor, variable) |> 
  unique() |> 
  group_by(site, project, sensor) |> 
  summarise(variables = paste0(variable, collapse = ", ")) |> 
  write_tsv("db/vars.tsv")
read_tsv("db/guyaclim.tsv") |> 
  group_by(site, project, sensor, id, variable) |> 
  summarise(n = n()) |> 
  group_by(site, project, sensor, variable) |> 
  summarise(min = min(n), median = median(n), max = max(n)) |> 
  write_tsv("db/obs.tsv")
```

Available variables are:

```{r vars}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
read_tsv("db/vars.tsv") |> knitr::kable()
```

Number of observations are:

```{r obs}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
read_tsv("db/obs.tsv") |> 
  knitr::kable(format.args = list(big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE))
```
